answer.summary: API types check failed because the committed front-end types in openaev-front/src/utils/api-types.d.ts do not match what the backend generates. The diff adds InjectAuthorisationInput and aiTargetToken, and changes ai_target_token_set from readonly to writable. The change must regenerate and commit the types. This is deterministic, so a retry will fail the same way.
